scaleBeatText: 👑 Speakers from Emberhold, Stonebridge, Thornfield ride in for the first court — and every one of them is measuring you. FEAST them from a shared granary (5,000 kcal, no strings), HOST the court at Haven's fire (your speaker's time), or write the law in COLD ink (they'll pay more and love you less). Or REFUSE the scale itself — stay a free fire at regional, whatever that costs. The System will not offer twice.
